location_exception_reason: Modular buildings are manufactured structures sold nationwide; location in title adds no buyer decision value. Origin/manufacturing location is not a GI-tagged or regional-origin product attribute.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Distributor) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Modular Building Manufacturer' leaves the product meaning unchanged.
